text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to design a training session 
utilizing the terrain for <chrname>, I was walking 
along the river taking notes on my phone 
when――

text_block_list.name: Giant Crow
text_block_list.text: Gah! Gwaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Startled by a giant crow that suddenly 
swooped in, I dropped my smartphone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The smartphone kept tumbling noisily 
across the gravel――
choice_data_list: (At this rate, right into the river...!)

text_block_list.text: I'll go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WHOOSH――!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Like a sudden gust of wind. A shadow so 
fast it seemed almost an illusion darted 
across, diving straight into――the river!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: *gasp*, ngh――...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Thank goodness! The screen turned on 
properly. Looks like we made it in time.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Oh, right.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, with me looking like this, it's 
just going to end up soaking wet either 
way. I'll give it right back, right now—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle looks utterly bewildered, but 
naturally, things can't be left like 
this...!
choice_data_list:
I'll figure out a way to warm us up right 
away!

First, let's check your gait to make sure 
you're not injured!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Remembering there was a cafe nearby, I 
hurried over to buy some hot drinks.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I'm so sorry you went to the 
trouble.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... I don't have any money on me right 
now. Would it be okay if I ran back to the 
dorm to get it and pay you back?
choice_data_list: You don't have to return it!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I-Is that right?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Trainer... You really are so very 
kind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Are you really one to talk?" ...I thought 
from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Are you really one to talk?" ...I thought 
from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
――Yes, I am fine. Nothing hurts, nor does 
anything feel out of place.
choice_data_list: Are you really sure you're okay...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, yes! I'm fine. Nothing to worry 
about.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
These legs are my pride and joy. 
...They're mine, protected and raised by 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: So I'm totally fine. Really, I'm okay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She declared it with such straightforward 
conviction that I found myself rendered 
completely speechless...
